name: paretoPDFReal_pos
statement: 0 < t) (hr : 0 < r) (hx : t ≤ x) : 0 < paretoPDFReal t r x

name: isProbabilityMeasure_paretoMeasure
statement: 0 < t) (hr : 0 < r) : IsProbabilityMeasure (paretoMeasure t r) where measure_univ

name: cdf_paretoMeasure_eq_lintegral
statement: 0 < t) (hr : 0 < r) (x : ℝ) : cdf (paretoMeasure t r) x = ENNReal.toReal (∫⁻ x in Iic x, paretoPDF t r x)
